item.title: Fixing Build Failures: Avoiding Internal API Calls in Next.js getStaticProps
item.description:
“Fixing Build Failures: Avoiding Internal API Calls in Next.js getStaticProps”

When developing with Next.js, developers sometimes encounter build process interruptions, particularly when employing getStaticProps or getStaticPaths. A common pitfall involves attempting to call an internal API route from within these server-side functions. This practice can lead to build failures because API routes might not be initialized or accessible during the static generation phase.

What is the recommended approach for sourcing data within Next.js static generation functions when direct API calls are problematic?
